name: get_model_info
title: Get Revit model info
description: Get the title, file path, active view and view count of the Revit model currently open.

name: get_warnings
title: Get Revit model warnings
description: List the warnings in the open Revit model, grouped by description with counts and the element ids involved. Use this to audit model health.

maxIdsPerGroup.description: Max element ids returned per warning group, default 20

name: list_views
title: List Revit views
description: List views in the open Revit model. Optionally filter by view type (e.g. FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, Section, ThreeD) or by text contained in the view name. Returns id, name and type for each.

nameContains.description: Only views whose name contains this text

name: rename_views
title: Rename Revit views
description: Rename one or more views in the open Revit model. Supply an array of {id, newName}. Get ids from list_views first. View names must be unique within a view type.

name: get_categories_by_keywords
title: Find Revit categories
description: Find Revit categories whose name contains any of the given keywords. Returns the category id needed by the other category tools. Always call this first - category ids are negative numbers that cannot be guessed.

keywords.description: Words to match against category names, e.g. ['Door','Window']

name: count_elements_by_category
title: Count elements by category
description: Count placed element instances in one or more categories. Cheap - use this before get_elements_by_category to see how big the result will be.

name: get_elements_by_category
title: Get elements in a category
description: Get placed elements in a category, grouped by family and type with element ids. Ids can be passed to set_selection. Use maxIdsPerType to cap the response on large categories.

maxIdsPerType.description: Max ids returned per type group, default 50

groupByType.description: Group by family and type, default true

name: set_selection
title: Select elements in Revit
description: Select elements in the open Revit model by element id, and scroll the active view to show them. Pass an empty array to clear the selection.

name: get_element_parameters
title: Get all parameters of one element
description: List every parameter on a single element, with values, storage types and whether each is read-only. Use this first to discover exact parameter names before reading or writing across many elements. Double values are in Revit internal units (feet); the 'display' field shows the formatted value.

includeType.description: Also return the element type's parameters, default true

name: get_parameter_values
title: Read parameters across many elements
description: Read named parameters across many elements, grouped by value by default so large sets stay compact. Falls back to the element type when an instance has no such parameter. Get exact names from get_element_parameters first.

groupByValue.description: Group ids by shared value, default true

name: set_parameter_value
title: Set a parameter on many elements
description: Write one instance parameter across many elements. Defaults to a dry run that reports what would change without changing it - call with dryRun false to commit. Only instance parameters are written, never type parameters. Double values must be supplied in Revit internal units (feet).

newValue.description: New value as text; converted to the parameter's storage type

name: list_sheets
title: List Revit sheets
description: List sheets in the open Revit model with number, name and the views placed on each. Optionally filter by text in the sheet number or name.

nameContains.description: Only sheets whose number or name contains this text

includeViews.description: Include the views placed on each sheet, default true

name: list_titleblocks
title: List title block types
description: List the title block types loaded in the model, with the ids that create_sheets needs.

name: create_sheets
title: Create Revit sheets
description: Create one or more sheets. Each needs a name; the number is optional (Revit assigns one if omitted). Uses titleBlockTypeId if given, otherwise the first title block in the model - call list_titleblocks first to choose properly. Sheet numbers must be unique.

titleBlockTypeId.description: Title block type id from list_titleblocks

name: rename_sheets
title: Renumber or rename Revit sheets
description: Change the number and/or name of one or more sheets. Get ids from list_sheets. Swapping numbers between sheets in one request is supported. The whole batch rolls back if Revit rejects any change.

name: place_views_on_sheets
title: Place views on sheets
description: Place views or schedules on sheets. Position is in millimetres from the sheet origin; omit xMm and yMm to centre the view on the sheet. A view can only be on one sheet (schedules and legends excepted) - the failure reason says which sheet already holds it.

xMm.description: X position in mm from the sheet origin

yMm.description: Y position in mm from the sheet origin

name: list_levels
title: List levels
description: List the levels in the model, lowest first, with elevation in millimetres and the plan views that already exist on each level. Use it to find level ids and to see which levels are missing a plan.

name: list_view_templates
title: List view templates
description: List the view templates in the model and the view type each applies to. Optionally filter by view type, e.g. FloorPlan.

viewType.description: Only templates for this ViewType, e.g. FloorPlan

name: create_plan_views
title: Create plan views
description: Create floor, ceiling or structural plans on one or more levels. Get level ids from list_levels. Optionally name each view and apply a view template as it is created.

plans.description: One entry per view to create

name.description: View name; Revit names it after the level if omitted

viewFamilyTypeId.description: Specific view family type; the first of the right kind is used if omitted

name: duplicate_views
title: Duplicate views
description: Duplicate one or more views. Mode 'duplicate' copies the view only, 'with_detailing' also copies annotation and detailing, 'dependent' creates a dependent view. Use this when a view is already on a sheet and needs to appear on another.

newName.description: Name for the copy; Revit generates one if omitted

name: apply_view_template
title: Apply or remove a view template
description: Apply a view template to many views, or remove templates by omitting templateId. Applying a template overrides each view's own settings, so this defaults to a dry run - call with dryRun false to commit. Views of a type the template doesn't suit are reported, not changed.

templateId.description: Template id from list_view_templates; omit to remove templates

name: list_schedulable_fields
title: List schedulable fields
description: List the field names a schedule of the given category can include. Call this before create_schedule - field names must match exactly. Get the category id from get_categories_by_keywords.

nameContains.description: Only fields whose name contains this text

name: create_schedule
title: Create a schedule
description: Create a schedule for a category with the given fields, in order. Field names come from list_schedulable_fields; unknown names are reported and skipped. Optionally sort by one or more of the included fields, and choose itemized (one row per element) or grouped.

sortBy.description: Fields to sort by, in priority order; each must also be in fields

itemized.description: One row per element, default true; false groups identical rows

name: get_schedule_data
title: Read a schedule
description: Read the contents of a schedule as rows of text, exactly as Revit displays them. The first row or rows are the column headings. Find schedule ids with list_views and viewType Schedule.
